subject: Culture
title: Pointing and Gesturing
description: Learn Pointing and Gesturing in one minute.

hook.text: Point with your index finger in Malaysia and you've just made a rude gesture.

buildup.text: Many Southeast Asian cultures use the thumb or the whole hand to show direction.

discovery.text: The OK sign means zero in France, money in Japan, and is offensive in Brazil and Turkey.

twist.text: Thumbs-up upset Iranian visitors for decades. In their culture it's an obscene gesture.

climax.text: A single hand shape can open a door or slam it shut depending on the country.

punchline.text: Your hands don't speak the same language everywhere.

quiz.question: In which country does the OK hand sign mean 'money'?
